tasks.short: Prepare and deliver recreation and fitness lectures

steps.what: Select lecture objectives and authoritative anatomy, recreation or conditioning material
Prepare lecture explanations, examples and supporting materials

loop.purpose: Propose explanations from selected authoritative teaching material
loop.output: Draft explanations and examples with source references
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific accuracy, learning alignment, clarity and unsafe or misleading exercise examples
loop.stop: One revision maximum; unsupported explanations return to manual preparation
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates arrange slides but cannot adapt explanations to student misunderstandings

steps.what: Check and deliver lectures and respond to student questions

tasks.design: Reuse native templates and approved explanations in {DOCS} first. A bounded drafting step proposes audience-appropriate wording; the teacher checks the exact lecture version and retains delivery and questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clear explanations take preparation even when sources and objectives are known.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can suggest wording from selected material.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific accuracy and responding to misunderstandings about health or exercise.
tasks.human_edge: Adjust explanations after seeing what students actually understand.
tasks.altitude: A small preparation benefit returns time to teaching interaction.

evidence.claim: Source-constrained lecture drafting may reduce some composition effort; the small net saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation and delivery of individual lectures, excluding curriculum redesign and examinations allocated separately.

Teacher captures objectives, student level, duration, selected source versions, permitted examples and excluded claims in s1's 25 hours. Missing scientific support causes omission or manual preparation within retained s2 time.
Native templates and material reuse are tested before a model extension; existing software runtime earns no saving.
No personalised exercise prescription or automated student advice is issued.
research_questions: Does draft wording save time after checking scientific accuracy and learning alignment?

already_counted.description: Check and revise draft lecture explanations

incremental.description: Refresh sources and review recurring drafting errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact final lecture slides, notes, examples and source versions; changes void approval before delivery

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=25+20+50=95, gross=5, upkeep=3, net=2. Range 0-1 allows extensive scientific correction and delivery-heavy work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate and revise recreation and fitness curricula

steps.what: Evaluate curricula and identify required changes in content and instructional methods
Revise course content and materials to address the identified curriculum needs

loop.purpose: Propose changes that follow the teacher's identified learning needs
loop.input: Revision brief, existing course content and approved sources
loop.output: Draft revisions with objective mappings and change reasons
loop.check: Teacher checks scientific accuracy, assessment alignment, workload and whether each proposed change addresses the actual evidence
loop.stop: One revision maximum; unsupported or misaligned changes are rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates cannot determine the wording of context-specific instructional revisions

steps.what: Select defensible curriculum changes and prepare the reviewed course version

tasks.design: Use native document comparison and curriculum templates in {DOCS} first. A bounded draft step proposes changes from the teacher's evaluation; the teacher selects the reviewed course version for the existing course-approval process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing coherent revisions takes time after learning gaps are identified.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting can suggest revisions grounded in a stated learning need.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what students should learn and whether a method actually improves understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret learning evidence in the context of the course and students.
tasks.altitude: A modest composition benefit supports careful evaluation of course changes.

evidence.claim: Drafting revisions from a teacher's evaluation is plausible, but its local net saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is curriculum evaluation and revision, excluding individual lecture composition and formal course approval. Common writing work must be assigned once in a roll-up.

Teacher records current version, objectives, identified learning gaps, supporting evidence, scope, workload constraints and source versions in s1's 50 hours. Missing evaluation evidence prevents automated proposals and returns to ordinary human revision.
Native templates and comparison are tested before a model extension; existing runtime earns no saving.
The output is a reviewed proposal, not automatic publication or approval of a course.
unknowns: Quality of learning evidence and existing curriculum templates
research_questions: Do draft revisions reduce composition time after scientific and pedagogical checking?

already_counted.description: Check and revise generated curriculum proposals

incremental.description: Maintain source and objective mappings and check recurring drafting failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+21+20=91, gross=9, upkeep=5, net=4. Range 0-2 allows substantial rewriting and novel curriculum work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Stay current through literature and professional exchange

steps.what: Read current literature and assess developments in recreation and fitness studies
Discuss developments with colleagues and participate in professional conferences

tasks.design: Keep critical reading and professional exchange with the teacher, using literature in {DOCS}. Discovery tools can locate material, but no saving is assigned to replacing the learning itself with summaries.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding developments requires appraisal and discussion rather than information delivery alone.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change removes the disciplinary learning time.
tasks.still_hard: Judging evidence quality and relevance to teaching.
tasks.human_edge: Connect new evidence with professional experience and challenge interpretations.

evidence.claim: Critical reading and professional exchange remain human learning work; no local saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers reading and professional exchange, excluding conference logistics and formal literature-review administration not established by the task.
No machine-selected truth label or automatic acceptance of research findings is introduced.
Native literature access and alerts can continue without new configuration or runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed.
unknowns: Literature access and professional learning format
research_questions: Is source discovery a distinct measurable burden outside substantive reading?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+45=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Reading and professional learning retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade examinations fairly

steps.what: Compile examinations and establish defensible answer keys and marking criteria
Administer examinations and manage access, questions and exceptional circumstances
Grade closed-response examination items against the explicit answer key
Grade interpretive work, check examination results and release final marks

tasks.design: Configure native closed-item marking in {LMS} after the teacher establishes the exact key and scoring rules. The teacher administers the assessment, grades interpretive work and checks provisional results before releasing the final marks; no model grades students.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated marking of explicit closed responses consumes time without changing the judgement standard.
tasks.enabler_now: Assessment systems can mark closed items against defined keys.
tasks.still_hard: Question validity, accommodations, ambiguous items and interpretive answers.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a mechanically correct mark is unfair because the question or key is flawed.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical marking, with retained authority over assessment quality and final marks.

reach.learn: Item analysis and defensible scoring rules

evidence.claim: Ans supports closed-item automatic marking and separate open-answer assessment; the closed-item labour saving still depends on the local exam mix.

assumptions: Boundary covers the teacher's exam compilation, administration and grading. Student effort is unchanged outside focal savings; no work is transferred to assistants.

Teacher produces examination version, item identifiers, exact accepted answers, scoring weights and missing-answer rules in s1's 30 hours. Students produce responses during s2; teacher checks capture includes student and attempt identifiers, item, answer, version and submission state within s2's 20 hours. Missing or ambiguous responses bypass automatic marking and are resolved manually in s4.
Native marking configuration is tested before custom code. Existing automatic marking receives no new saving; the scenario requires a currently manual closed-item share.
All interpretive grading and final checking remain in s4. Practical or essay-only examinations have zero closed-item benefit.
unknowns: Closed-item share and existing automatic marking
research_questions: Does native closed-item marking save time after key validation and final result checking?

already_counted.description: Grade interpretive work, correct key problems and check final results

incremental.description: Maintain item keys and regression-test changed scoring rules

approvals.approved_version: Exact final student mark set bound to examination, key, response and scoring versions; changes void approval before release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+20+0+30=80, gross=20, upkeep=6, net=14. Range 0-8 allows few closed items, existing automatic marking and key corrections.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The teacher retains scientific, pedagogical and grading judgement while selected drafting and closed-item marking reduce preparation effort.
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who uses modest preparation support and spends the returned time on student understanding and fair assessment.

job.title: Recreation and Fitness Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
